comments.value: This is a shader issue in worlds, not something VRChat can fix. You should report this to the world author.

details:
## Summary

On AMD Radeon RX 6000 series hardware, the planar reflection on water surfaces is offset

from the real scene, producing a visible seam / mismatch along the waterline. It only

appears while the viewing camera is moving.

## Defining conditions

- **Only while the camera is moving.** With the camera perfectly still, the reflection lines

  up exactly and there is no artifact.

- **Independent of movement speed.** Rotating the view slowly or quickly produces the same

  amount of misalignment.

- **The amplitude varies a lot between worlds, and can be very large.** In

  "Nights Edge · 宵の果て" it is very pronounced — a large, obvious offset with strong

  jitter along the waterline while turning the view. In other worlds the same artifact is

  present but noticeably milder.

- **It is inside the rendered frame, not display tearing.** The seam is visible in a screen

  recording of the game, so it is not a monitor / scanout artifact.

- **Main view vs in-game camera.** With both views on screen at once, whichever view is moving

  shows the artifact and the stationary one is clean. This holds in both directions (camera

  moving / main view still, and main view moving / camera still).

- **VRChat's built-in mirror shows no artifact.** Note that a world mirror does not render the

  water's own planar reflection, so the water is absent from the mirror image entirely.

Not affected by: in-game graphics quality, anti-aliasing setting, D3D feature level, shader

cache, or graphics driver version.

## Environment

- GPU: AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT (RDNA2 / Navi 23)

- Driver: AMD Software Adrenalin Edition 26.9.2, driver 32.0.21045.11001

- VRChat: 2026.3.3-1919-27c41b24d2-Release

- Unity: 6000.0.67f1-DWR

- Graphics API: Direct3D 11.0 [level 11.1]

- OS: Windows 11 25H2, build 26200.9445

- Display: 1920x1080 @ 180 Hz

- CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 5600

## Worlds where it reproduces

Most pronounced:

- `wrld_5f56dc7f-9786-401a-8996-1b61c785d90f` — "Nights Edge · 宵の果て"

Also present (milder):

- `wrld_2dfd7562-8127-4091-856b-f34a2947b22b` — "【公式】仮想空間＜ツクヨミ＞【超かぐや姫！】"

(closed; same symptom reported on RX 6600 and RX 5700 XT, and one user reports it

disappears completely on NVIDIA hardware)

title: Water reflection seam appears only while the camera moves — AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT
